By embodying the qualities of a Zabiyah, one can carry the light of happiness and positivity within them, illuminating their own soul and spreading it to others. Additionally, as a reminder of the infinite mercy and compassion of Allah, embracing the name Zabiyah as a spiritual practice can help foster a deep sense of gratitude and contentment in a believer's heart. The name signifies the importance of cultivating a joyful and positive disposition towards life, and a reminder of the blessings that Allah bestows upon us daily.
